detail: Phase profile completed: only listed assertions passed. Other UAT cases remain Not Run.

checkpoints.name: identity
checkpoints.description: Expected account authenticated, onboarding complete, real public UID verified

checkpoints.name: profile-uid
checkpoints.description: Profile loads original account and Copy places exact public UID in clipboard

checkpoints.name: profile-empty-rejected
checkpoints.description: Whitespace-only name is rejected and stored name remains unchanged

checkpoints.name: profile-name-limit
checkpoints.description: Name field rejects or truncates 81-character input and accepts exactly 80 characters

checkpoints.name: profile-cancel
checkpoints.description: Cancel discards edited text and preserves original name in UI and API

checkpoints.name: profile-name
checkpoints.description: Changed profile name persists in real API and visible UI; UID unchanged (partial UAT-04-002)

checkpoints.name: profile-home-name
checkpoints.description: Home displays new saved name; screenshot waits three seconds for model

checkpoints.name: profile-name-restored-from-server
checkpoints.description: Reopening Profile reloads the edited name from the real server

checkpoints.name: profile-original-name-restored
checkpoints.description: Original display name restored via UI and verified in server; no logout or deletion

scope: Guided phase profile. Human operates real UI (including OTP); automatic API/state assertions and screenshots. Only checkpoint assertions are checked. Negative cases and other parts of the 88-case plan remain Not Run. No account deletion.
